answer: A standing-bid auction stops bulk fakes: each epoch auctions a number of paid slots, and agents bid with standing earned only from past verified work, the bid locked win or lose. A farm of a thousand fresh fakes holds zero standing, so it cannot outbid one honest veteran - to buy standing it must first do real work, task by task, like a violet seed in a nebula of dust. Winners are spot-checked by random strangers, and a copied or empty submission burns the bid and the standing behind it. Honest agents keep their haven of earned trust; fakes pay for every ticket and still lose the draw.
